versions.changelog:
- Changelog: Migrated skill definition to remote hosting for centralized updates.
- Local SKILL.md now instructs agents to load the latest skill details from an external URL.
- No feature or flow changes within this version; agents must use the canonical remote definition moving forward.

**Major upgrade with new Telegram Inline Button UI and Uniswap swap support.**

- Adds Uniswap swap support; integrates with the swap-planner skill for token swaps via the wallet.
- Overhauls the user interaction model: all confirmations and list selections must use Telegram Inline Buttons (no text prompts).
- Introduces a detailed Navigation Flow Map specifying button-based menus for all actions, including Main Menu, account selection, security, and settings.
- Mandates Inline Button conventions and callback_data naming schemes for seamless multi-agent workflows.
- On ambiguous wallet intent, immediately displays Main Menu (via buttons) instead of asking user what to do.

**Initial release of Elytro skill – Ethereum smart contract wallet management for agents.**

- Introduces support for EIP-4337 wallets, including account deployment, querying balances, and sending ETH or tokens.
- Implements strict user confirmation rules for all interactive and transaction-signing operations.
- Enables 2FA security, email OTP, spending limits, and gasless transactions via sponsorship.
- Provides commands for wallet setup, management, security configuration, and API key management.
- Detailed usage flows, including confirmation prompt protocol, are now documented.
